label: Kyriba claim boundary
query: If Kyriba is not live yet, what exactly can Lakeshore claim today without overstating value?
answer: My read For Lakeshore Holdings today, you can confidently claim Kyriba as a well-advanced, stage-backed selection program with robust due diligence completed through BAFO – but you should not claim live operational value, realized savings, or execution outcomes yet. Why Your Kyriba event (LSH-KYRIBA-TREASURY-2026) has Strategy through BAFO approved. That means you can point to: problem statement, requirements, market scan, vendor evaluations, and a completed commercial/solution negotiation. Executive Decision, Selection, Transition, and Value are still in review / needs-review states. So any “chosen vendor”, “go-live”, “savings delivered”, or “risk reduction achieved” language would be overstated. Azure AI Search and the Source spine give you defensible, retrievable artifacts to back these claims – you can show the actual strategy deck, evaluation matrices, and BAFO analysis if challenged. Decision fork Conservative posture (what I recommend): Position Kyriba as “our leading, fully-evaluated candidate for treasury modernization, with completed BAFO and decision materials in review.” Aggressive posture (higher risk): Call Kyriba “our intended treasury platform, pending formal executive approval,” but still avoid any language implying implementation or realized value. What I would say today (externally or to the Board) “Lakeshore has completed a full Kyriba evaluation and BAFO for treasury modernization; executive decision and implementation are now in review.” “We have a documented business case and vendor selection artifacts; value is projected, not yet realized, because Kyriba is not live.Evidence checked: intake.tenant_context (loaded tenant context), telemetry.value_attestation (verified versus projected value), intake.missing_fields (missing or stale evidence fields), intake.question_scope (question scope).
